requestReview.reason: Group drops retain their measured budget. Remote update sends one explicit command write through the existing listener; no new polling/listener. Agent manifest checks, rollout reads and update telemetry are also affected and are not covered by the earlier grouping-only dailyBudget. The Agent scheduled task is local Windows state and adds no cloud request, polling, listener or retry.
requestReview.remoteUpdateBudgetStatus: Incomplete: sender boundary proves one write/no read/no retry; receiver policy proves duplicate/expired/shutdown suppression. Combined device-rule reads, existing listener delivery/ack writes, PC rollout/telemetry and Android consent/installation telemetry still need end-to-end request counting. Do not use the grouping-only dailyBudget as a fleet total or pass deployment based on it.
requestReview.assumptions: Incremental budget only: 10 Viewers each perform 20 deliberate moves daily. Central Viewer metadata rules use authentication claims/UID without dependent document reads. Existing fleet traffic is outside this change budget. No added polling or automatic inheritance writes.

outcomes.acceptance: When administrator approval is required, the Agent installer first explains in Korean that this is a WonRemote installation or update and asks the user to press Yes in the following Windows prompt. It then replaces the WonRemote Agent login task with the installed executable and --agent argument, starts that task after install or update, launches it at the next interactive login with highest privileges, and removes it on uninstall.
